properties.name: A read after a write costs at most 2x the same read warm
properties.statement: A read tool's reply, when it is the first read after a write, costs no more than TWICE what the same read costs warm. Derived, not picked: a read must cost what a read costs, and a courtesy appended to it must not cost more than the thing it decorates. Measured 2026-09-05 before any change: get_node warm 1.3 ms, get_node after a write 7,700 ms - a ratio of ~5,900. The cause is service.rs:3731 read_loop_hint recomputing a full loop_status on the first read after every write; the spender is every read tool in the surface. Anthony accepted this budget 2026-09-05. Bounds: release build, this machine (4 cores), live store, stdio; a ratio so both halves move together under load, per the optimize skill's rule that a duration assertion in a shared suite measures contention.
